slug: 2025-07-09 Liberia appoints steering committee for NBIS rollout by April 2026

facts.fact: A presidential steering committee was appointed on the National Biometric Identification System with a rollout deadline of 13 April 2026, the system being designed to support social welfare, banking and SIM registration.

note: Fact recorded under the ID system's planned support for other services; as_of is the published date, the document gives no other.
